create_video_transform: create a VideoTransform instance with configurable augmentation options for video frame processing
make_transforms_factory: build a VideoTransform using the make_transforms factory function with custom crop size and normalization
apply_video_augmentation: apply spatial transforms, horizontal flip, and normalization to a video frame buffer tensor
normalize_tensor: normalize a PyTorch tensor by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation
normalize_tensor_inplace: normalize a C T H W tensor in-place using mean and std values scaled to 0-255 range
